---
title: "Climate & Fisheries Research"
---

I am primarily interested in the localization and contextualization of large scale climate and ecosystem change. Given the complexities of fisheries and how they are influenced by not only environmental change but regulatory, market, and behavioral trends as well, working in fisheries has been an excellent ecosystem for applying climate decision frameworks. In quantifying changes in commercial fishing, I hope to aid people and institutions as we understand, navigate, and manage the impact climate change has on our daily lives.
